title: AI Engineer Agentic Track: The Complete Agent & MCP Course
summary: A six-week, hands-on program on designing, building and deploying autonomous AI agents with the main agent frameworks and MCP.
syllabus: Week 1: Agent foundations, design patterns, tool calling, context engineering and the Career Digital Twin
Week 2: OpenAI Agents SDK
Week 3: CrewAI
Week 4: LangGraph
Week 5: AutoGen
Week 6: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
projects: Career Digital Twin: an agent that represents you to employers
SDR Agent: agents that write and send sales emails
Deep Research: a team of agents that researches any topic
4-Agent Engineering Team with CrewAI and coder agents in Docker
Sidekick: a browser-based Operator-style agent with LangGraph
Agent Creator: an agent that builds and launches new agents with AutoGen
Capstone: a Trading Floor of 4 agents using 6 MCP servers and 44 tools

title: The Complete SQL Bootcamp (30 Hours): Go from Zero to Hero
summary: A visual, hands-on SQL course from the basics to advanced techniques, built around real enterprise use cases and three practical projects.
syllabus: Introduction to SQL, databases and environment setup (SQL Server, SSMS)
Querying and filtering: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY
Data definition and manipulation: CREATE, ALTER, DROP, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
Combining data: INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL and CROSS joins, UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT
Row-level functions: string, numeric, date and time, NULL handling and CASE
Aggregation and window functions: RANK, DENSE_RANK, ROW_NUMBER, LAG, LEAD
Advanced SQL: subqueries, CTEs (recursive and non-recursive), views, temp tables, stored procedures and triggers
Performance optimization: indexes, partitions and query tuning
Using AI tools (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot) to write, explain and debug SQL
projects: SQL Data Warehouse: designing and building a full data warehouse from scratch
SQL for Data Analysis: exploratory data analysis on real-world datasets
Advanced Query Optimization: performance tuning on large datasets

title: Complete 2026 Python Bootcamp: Learn Python from Scratch
summary: A beginner-to-advanced Python course built around hands-on projects, from core language fundamentals to OOP, file handling, external libraries and an AI-powered SaaS project.
syllabus: Introduction to programming and Python: setup, first program and syntax
Python fundamentals, control flow and loops
Strings, functions and modules
Data structures in Python
Object-oriented programming: classes, objects and inheritance
Advanced Python concepts
File I/O and working with files
Working with external libraries: Flask, Requests and Shutil
Coding with AI tools such as Cursor and GitHub Copilot
projects: Practical projects such as calculators, games and automation scripts
VidSnapAI: an AI-powered SaaS project using ElevenLabs, FFmpeg and Python
Full-stack web applications with Flask as the backend

title: AI Engineer Production Track: Deploy LLMs & Agents at Scale
summary: A four-week course on taking LLM apps and agents to production: cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability and guardrails across Vercel, AWS, Azure and GCP.
syllabus: Week 1: SaaS app live in production with Vercel, AWS, Next.js, Clerk and App Runner
Week 2: AI platform engineering on AWS with Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, Terraform and CI/CD
Week 3: GenAI in production with Azure, GCP, AWS SageMaker, S3 Vectors and MCP
Week 4: Agentic AI in production: a multi-agent system on AWS with Aurora Serverless, Lambda, SQS, LangFuse and Bedrock AgentCore
